title: Using devices of style and tone (2)

instruction.text: Complete the devices of style and tone in the text with words from the word bank.

atoms.b: The king declared, “What a ((glorious)) day for peace,” as thunder rolled and swords clashed outside the walls. The messenger carried a letter of ((betrayal)) tucked inside his cloak, though the king smiled in ignorance. The royal ((guard)), guardian of fire, was the first to burn. Tell me — can a crown ever outlast ((time))?

Tell me — can a crown ever outlast time?
